title: Private Baseball Lessons in Huntington Beach, CA | MBM Baseball Training
description: 1-on-1 youth baseball lessons in Huntington Beach — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and mindset with Coach Myles. Free first lesson.
h1: Private Baseball Lessons in Huntington Beach
lead: Huntington Beach is about 25 minutes down the coast from our Long Beach home base — and one of Orange County's deepest youth-baseball towns, which is exactly why individual coaching pays off here.
body: HB takes its baseball seriously. Ocean View Little League brought home a Little League World Series title in 2011, and programs like Seaview Little League have anchored the southeast side of town for decades. In a city with that kind of talent pool, private reps are how players separate themselves.

Coach Myles works hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and baseball IQ in true 1-on-1 sessions — but the through-line is mechanics and mindset: building a swing or a delivery that repeats under pressure, and the competitive headspace to use it. We meet your player at a field that works for your family.
Whether the goal is making the All-Star team or just falling back in love with the game, the free first lesson is a no-pressure place to start.

faq.q: Do you travel to Huntington Beach?
faq.a: Yes — about 25 minutes from home base. We meet your player at a convenient HB field.

faq.q: Can you help with All-Star or travel-ball prep?
faq.a: That's a lot of what we do — focused 1-on-1 work to sharpen the specific skills coaches and scouts notice.

faq.q: What does the first lesson include?
faq.a: A free 30-minute skill evaluation and Q&A with Coach Myles, plus a preview of a development plan — no obligation.
